m.english: I'm with the Federal Department of Emergency Management.

translation.text: I'm with the Federal Department of Emergency Management.

m.english: Emergency rooms all over the city have been filled with people complaining about headaches.

target.text: Las emergencias de la ciudad están llenas con gente con dolores de cabeza.
